alerts.headline: Asian Paints, IndiGo rise up to 4%, lead gains in aviation, paints, tyre stocks as crude oil falls nearly 8%
alerts.summary: Asian Paints, IndiGo, tyre manufacturers and oil marketing companies gained as crude oil prices plunged nearly 8% on hopes of US-Iran peace talks. ONGC and Oil India declined.

alerts.headline: Q2 results impact: KRBL shares rally 13% as September quarter profit jumps 51%
alerts.summary: KRBL Ltd, the maker of India Gate basmati rice, reported a 51 percent year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 259 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with Rs 172 crore in the corresponding quarter of the last fiscal.

alerts.headline: Diwali stock picks 2026: Angel One's 8 ‘Shagun Ke Shares’ with up to 32% upside; ICICI Bank, Shanti Gold, Northern Arc and more
alerts.summary: Angel One's eight festive-season picks – ‘Shagun Ke Shares’ as called by the brokerage - reflect this optimism, each positioned for fresh momentum into Samvat 2083.

alerts.headline: Engineers India: Consultancy-led growth and record order book strengthen earnings outlook

alerts.headline: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
alerts.summary: The allotment of Bombay Coated & Special Steels' initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised on November 3, following a strong response from investors. The Rs 183.06-crore IPO was subscribed 60.77 times by the close of bidding

alerts.headline: Q2 results impact: Mold-Tek shares extend gains, rise nearly 15% in two sessions
alerts.summary: The buying interest followed the company's Q2 FY27 results, with consolidated revenue rising 30.5 percent to Rs 274 crore from Rs 210 crore in the year-ago quarter.

alerts.headline: Price Action: Jupiter Wagons gains 2% on order win; KEC International slides 7% after weak Q2 earnings

alerts.headline: IndiGo stock jumps 3.5%, tops Nifty gainers as crude oil prices slump 7.6%; stock rises for third straight day
alerts.summary: IndiGo shares surged 3.5% to lead Nifty gainers, extending their three-day rally to 8.9%, as a 7.6% slump in crude oil prices raised hopes of relief from elevated aviation fuel costs.
